about_the_game:
• Twin-Stick Party Shooter

  • Up to 8 players in local multiplayer (controller required)

  • Up to 8 players with Steam Remote Play

  • A wide variety of weapons and abilities

  • Different game modes: Free for all, Teams, and more...

  • Character customization options

The Game

Attention! Behold Buhei! The wonder granted to humanity! Experience how believed boundaries fade away and the exquisite combination of game mechanics transcends the human mind.

Multiplayer

In this game, up to 8 players can compete against each other in friendly or less friendly rivalry at the same time. Buhei is THE party game! Gather your friends! Gather your enemies! Marvel together at the explosion of action on your screen.

Diverse Weapons

Watch out! Witness the symphony of firepower. A fantastic arsenal that gives you the opportunity to wreak havoc on your opponents. An inexhaustible selection awaits you. From high-speed projectiles to sophisticated traps that can outsmart even the cleverest opponents.

Crazy Abilities

Equip yourself with exciting abilities to outshine your opponents. Each one more thrilling and unexpected than the last! Harness the power of elemental spells from another reality, or wield artifacts of power that defy the laws of physics, like a hot dog. Use them to instill awe in your rivals.

Environments

And just when you thought it couldn't get any better, replayability reaches new heights with a majestic collection of meticulously designed environments that ensure each battle turns into a new contest of precision and wit.

Character Customization

On your upcoming journey, you have full self-expression, not only can you freely choose your playstyle. No! Your appearance is entirely up to you as well. With a palette of vibrant colors and a variety of extraordinary facial features, the abundance of options Buhei offers will leave you speechless.

Okay, now seriously:

Buhei is a fun twin-stick party shooter that is easy to learn and one of the few games that can actually be played locally with up to 8 players.

*To avoid lags with more than 4 players in Steam Remote Play, a stable internet connection is necessary. For smooth gameplay with 8 players, we recommend a connection with 200 Mbps or faster.
